artworks.title: Henrietta Maria, Queen of Charles I
artworks.artist: Hendrik Danckerts after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is turned slightly to her right, looking directly at the viewer. The woman has well-defined facial features, including prominent eyes and a composed expression. Her hair is styled in loose curls that fall over her shoulders. She is wearing elegant clothing with intricate patterns, voluminous fabric around her shoulders, and jewelry including a pearl necklace and earrings. In the background, there is a textured design framing her figure. Below her portrait are inscriptions indicating her title as "Henrietta Maria" and her status as a queen.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria (?)
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Nikolaus van der Horst
artworks.description: This image features an engraving with a portrait of a woman surrounded by ornate decorations and other figures. The woman's visible form includes her head and shoulders, centrally positioned and facing the viewer. She has delicate facial features with wavy, shoulder-length hair styled back with a decorative headpiece, and is dressed in an elaborate gown with lace trim, complemented by a pearl necklace and earrings. Around her portrait is a wreath-like frame with flowers, and two cherubs or putti are shown holding trumpets above. To the left, another cherub holds flowers near a bearded figure, and to the right, a knight in armor stands with a woman holding a plate of offerings. The background contains detailed engravings of greenery and scroll-like elements. Below the portrait, there is an inscribed plaque.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria, Queen of Charles I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman. She is displayed from the waist up, facing the viewer directly. Her facial features include wide, almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and closed lips. Her hair is styled voluminously, extending outward on either side with a fringe in the front. She wears an ornate dress with a wide neckline, lace trimming, and multiple rows of pearls around her neck and shoulders. A floral brooch is pinned at her chest, and she wears pearl earrings. The background features an oval frame with intricate patterns and ornamental motifs, suggesting a classical or historical theme. French text appears on a scroll beneath the portrait, framed by decorative flourishes.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria, Queen of Charles I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the chest up, facing forward with a slight turn of her head to the left. She has a composed expression, full lips, and almond-shaped eyes. Her hair is styled in a voluminous manner with curls framing her face and a decorative element enhancing the style. She wears an ornate dress with intricate patterns and lace details around the neckline. A series of rounded pearls decorate her chest, and she wears a double-strand pearl necklace with a drop pendant. The portrait is set within an elaborate decorative frame featuring curved lines, facial motifs, and floral embellishments. Surrounding the frame, text in script form names Henriette Marie as a queen blessed by divine grace.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria
artworks.description: The image depicts a historical figure in a medium shot, capturing the upper body. The person is facing forward with the head slightly turned to the left. They have distinct facial features with curly, shoulder-length hair adorned with pearls. The individual is dressed in a detailed garment, possibly a fur stole or cloak, and features a large cross-shaped brooch at the neckline. They wear a pearl necklace and matching earrings. In the background, there is an intricate pattern of horizontal lines providing texture. Surrounding the figure is an oval frame resembling a braided band. Below the portrait is a decorative element including a crown with a cross atop, flanked by two skulls with crossed bones.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria (?)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a figure seen from the waist up, facing slightly to the left. The person has curly, short hair with a headpiece, detailed facial features, and wears an intricate garment with accessories. They hold flowers in one hand and a staff in the other. The background shows a riverside village with structures and trees, enclosed in an oval border.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of Bohemia (?)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman's upper body in a slightly turned pose, facing towards the viewer. She has wavy hair, a small crown, and floral decorations. Her facial features are detailed, with high arched eyebrows and a calm expression. The woman wears a decorative gown with lace sleeves and floral ornaments, a pearl necklace with a pendant, drop earrings, and holds a staff or scepter. The background features draped fabric.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a woman. She is looking slightly towards the right and has detailed facial features with a soft expression, prominent eyes, and a delicate smile. Her hair is mostly covered by a veil, with some curls framing her face. She wears an ornate crown, an intricate garment with elaborate sleeves, jewelry, and holds a scepter in her right hand. The background includes architectural elements resembling a castle in the upper right corner and another structure in the upper left. The image is bordered by an oval frame.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria (?)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person shown from the waist up, positioned facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. The person has a calm expression with delicate facial features. Their hair is mostly covered by a veil with some strands visible. They wear an ornate garment with a high collar, puffed sleeves, a crown, a beaded necklace, and hoop earrings. They hold a scepter or staff in one hand. The background is an intricately shaded interior space with draped fabric surrounding the central figure, bordered by an oval frame.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving of a man from the chest up, facing slightly to the left, centered in an oval frame. He has a serious expression with a long, straight nose, slight chin, and long, curly hair flowing past his shoulders. He wears a high-collared garment with a cloak, a visible lace frill of a shirt, and a sash diagonally across his chest. The frame is decorated with text and decorative elements including a partial crown at the top right corner. The background has a pattern of fine lines, with text around the oval reading "CAROLVS SECVNDVS DEI GRATIA MAGNAE, BRITANNIAE, FRANCIAE, ET HIBERNIAE REX," and the engraving is signed with "Wolf Kilian exaud" at the bottom edge.

artworks.title: Charles II on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a man on horseback in the center. The man is seated upright on the saddle, holding the reins with one hand and resting the other on his hip. He has a composed expression, long curly hair, and a large hat. He wears an ornate outfit with a decorated coat, lace cuffs, knee-high boots, and a white neckcloth. The horse is also adorned. In the background, there are naval ships on the water, with clouds in the sky. The text at the bottom names him "Karel de II Koning van Engeland, Schotland, en Irland."

artworks.title: Prince Rupert (?)
artworks.description: The image depicts a head-and-shoulders portrait of an individual in a circular frame. The person appears upright and inverted simultaneously due to a visual illusion. The individual has wavy hair, a moustache, an elongated nose, and prominent eyebrows. They are facing slightly to the right and wearing historical clothing, possibly with a decorative collar. Inscriptions in cursive style are present along the inner edge of the circular frame. The background is plain and neutral, emphasizing the intricate etched portrait.

artworks.title: Princess Isabella of York, Daughter of James II While Duke of York
artworks.description: The image depicts a child standing in an elegant pose. The child faces slightly to the right with one hand resting on an object and the other arm bent at the elbow, holding a small bird. The child has rounded cheeks, a slightly upturned nose, short wavy hair, and a decorative hat with feathers. They are dressed in a detailed gown with a high collar, intricate buttons, puffed sleeves, and a voluminous skirt. A textured curtain drapes on both sides of the child, partially framing the figure. The floor is patterned with geometric tiles, indicating an interior setting.

artworks.title: William III (?)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with their body angled slightly to the side. They are clasping their hands together in front of them. The person has a prominent face with defined features, including a pointed nose and a slightly protruding chin. They have curly hair cascading over their shoulders. The person is wearing elaborate clothing, including a textured outfit and a cravat around the neck. They have a large hat with ribbons and feathers, and detailed shoes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a man portrayed from the chest up, facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. He has a pointed beard, mustache, high forehead, short wavy hair, and is wearing formal attire with a high white collar and a dark doublet with intricate buttons. Surrounding him are cherubic figures; two on each side of an oval frame holding a laurel wreath above his head, and a cherub below holds a shield with a map or chart while another cherub beside him is holding a fan-like object. The background is ornately engraved, providing texture to the image. Below the portrait is a decorative plaque with French inscription.

artworks.title: William Laud, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.description: The engraving shows a man in a three-quarter view facing right and looking at the viewer. He has a mustache, beard, and wavy, shoulder-length hair under a wide-brimmed hat. He wears a high-collared garment under robe-like clothing, with a chain around his neck. The background has trees and possibly a figure on horseback. The image is oval framed with text identifying him as Guillaume, Archbishop of Canterbury.

artworks.title: Edwin Sanders, Archbishop of York
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man, positioned facing forward but slightly turned to the side. His facial features include a long, pointed nose, expressive eyes, a furrowed brow, and a full beard with a mustache, which is mostly grey. His hairstyle is parted in the middle with hair flowing down towards the neck, and it appears to be receding from the front. He is wearing an Elizabethan-style high-collared garment with a pleated or ruffled collar and a robe that is etched with fine lines to indicate texture and folds. He is not seen wearing any jewelry or holding objects. The background is a plain, unadorned surface. At the bottom of the image, there is the text "Dr. Sandes" indicating the name of the individual depicted.

artworks.title: Sir Walter Raleigh
artworks.artist: after Simon de Passe after Robert Vaughan
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is facing forward but slightly turned to his left. He has a composed expression, a mustache, a beard, short hair, and is wearing an elaborate garment with a large collar and a sash. His right hand is visible holding a baton-like object. The background features an oval frame with floral and scroll elements, and a coat of arms with a checkerboard pattern surrounded by ribbon designs. Below the portrait, the text reads "Sʳ Walter Ralegh Kᵗ Ob: 1618 Ætat: 66."

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.description: The image is an oval portrait of a person facing forward with a slight turn to the left. The person has medium-length, dark, curly hair falling to the shoulders and a calm expression on their face. Their facial features include a smooth complexion, arched eyebrows, and a neutral mouth. They wear a high-collared garment with patterned detailing, an ornate sash across the chest, and decorative buttons or embellishments. No jewelry or objects are held. The background has a speckled texture, typical of engraved portraits.

artworks.title: Isaac Casawbon
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body facing forward. He has a long, pointed beard and a prominent mustache, with neatly combed hair. His facial expression is serious, with slightly furrowed eyebrows. He wears a dark garment with a high collar and buttons down the front. The oval frame around his portrait has the name "Isaac Casaubon" inscribed. The background shows a textured surface with a lighter area resembling clouds.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas More
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated man in a formal portrait style. He is slightly angled to the left with a solemn expression, prominent nose, heavy eyelids, short hair, and a wide-brimmed hat. He is wearing ornate attire with a fur collar, draped cloth secured by a floral brooch, and holding a rolled document in his left hand resting his right hand on a cylindrical object. The background features decorative engravings of ornamental columns and curved foliage designs.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple in the Dark Manner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene taking place within an architectural setting. The composition is rich in dark tones and intricate details, featuring an interior space with a group of figures gathered in a solemn manner. The scene is dominated by a large figure wearing an elaborate headdress, possibly holding a long staff or sceptre, which gives the impression of authority or religious significance. The surrounding architecture frames the gathering, with visible columns and an archway providing depth to the setting. The figures are rendered with a high level of detail, emphasizing their drapery and expressions, conveying a sense of gravity and importance. The entire drawing is executed in a dense, cross-hatched style that creates a dramatic play of light and shadow, lending a mysterious and intense atmosphere to the scene.

artworks.title: In an Elevator
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people closely gathered together, predominantly displaying from their knees upwards. At the center, an older woman with a round face is seen, wearing a dark hooded garment that covers her hair and most of her neck. She has her eyes downcast and a neutral expression. Surrounding her are several individuals, including a woman with braided hair to her left and others in the background, mostly hidden with only their faces and upper bodies visible. One person is wearing a flat cap and a jacket with bold buttons. The background is dark and textured, lacking distinct features, indicating an enclosed space like an elevator.

artworks.title: La Place Pigalle en 1878 (Place Pigalle in 1878)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and roulette with burnishing on turpentine soaked japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey in memory of her mother, Mrs. Addie Burr Clark
artworks.description: This is an urban street scene with a horse-drawn carriage and people walking on a cobblestone road. The scene shows a bustling street with a prominent horse-drawn omnibus in the center, surrounded by buildings and a small crowd of people. To the right, there are steps leading up, with individuals sitting or standing around, some holding umbrellas. Several other scenes are depicted in an overlay style, with additional activities and architecture rendered in a sketch-like manner. The drawing has a sepia tone.
